source_text: Proponents of deferral emphasize that the foreskin serves protective and sensory functions, and its excision—estimated to remove approximately 20,000–70,000 specialized nerve endings—alters the body's natural state permanently, akin to other non-therapeutic cuttings prohibited in medical ethics. [79]
